assignments.rule: A7 owns semantic identities, governed aliases, typed relationships and A7 policy.
Original binary/document/message content remains authoritative at its declared provider; A7 stores metadata/reference unless a later contract explicitly says otherwise.
Generated HTML, CSV, Mermaid, graph, search, Excalidraw and 3D outputs are never independently editable facts.
Do not mutate specialist domain truth until a module ownership contract assigns authority.
